To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the timeout algorithms can be decomposed into five layers or procedures.
the performance of timeout algorithms is highly sensitive to the choice of the five layers of the algorithm and that the choice of the layers can be made independent of each other.

(1) the timeout algorithms proposed in literature can be decomposed into a set of five layers, each of which is responsible for a specific task, (2) the layers can be chosen independently of each other, (3) the performance of the algorithms can be improved by modifying the layers, and (4) the performance can be further improved by using different timeout algorithms at different layers

a timeout algorithm can be decomposed into a number of layers.
the algorithms differ from one another in their choices for the layers.
